name: NOVA Julia-Motoko Bridge
description: A typed scientific-computing membrane for smart-contract systems. Bridges Julia high-performance numerical computing with Motoko Internet Computer smart contracts.

functions.name: phi_eigen
functions.candid_signature: linalg_eigen : (vec vec float64) -> (record { eigenvalues: vec float64; eigenvectors: vec vec float64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Eigenvectors may differ by sign convention. Compare by tolerance (1e-10).
functions.ai_usage: Use for matrix spectral analysis, graph dynamics, synchronization systems, PCA, stability analysis.

functions.name: phi_svd
functions.candid_signature: linalg_svd : (vec vec float64) -> (record { U: vec vec float64; S: vec float64; V: vec vec float64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Singular vectors may differ by sign. φ-weighted singular values decay by φ^(-i).
functions.ai_usage: Use for dimensionality reduction, matrix rank computation, pseudoinverse, data compression.

functions.name: phi_gradient_descent
functions.julia_signature: phi_gradient_descent(f, x0; max_iter=φ×100, tol=AMOR) -> (Vector{Float64}, Vector{Vector{Float64}}, Int64)
functions.motoko_signature: optim_gradient_descent(f: (vec Float) -> Float, x0: [Float]) : async OptimResult
functions.candid_signature: optim_gradient_descent : (vec float64) -> (record { optimum: vec float64; iterations: nat64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Uses φ⁻¹ as learning rate (provably optimal for many convex functions). Convergence threshold is AMOR (φ⁻²).
functions.ai_usage: Use for optimization problems, neural network training, parameter fitting. Heavy compute should be off-chain.

functions.name: kuramoto_step
functions.motoko_signature: kuramoto_step(oscillators: [(Float, Float)], K: Float, dt: Float) : async [(Float, Float)]
functions.candid_signature: kuramoto_step : (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 }, float64, float64) -> (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Use K=φ⁻¹ for optimal coupling. Use dt=HEARTBEAT_MS/1000 for NOVA heartbeat synchronization.
functions.ai_usage: Use for oscillator synchronization, swarm coherence, neural network coupling, heartbeat coordination.

functions.name: order_parameter
functions.candid_signature: order_parameter : (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 }) -> (float64)
functions.numeric_notes: Returns R ∈ [0, 1]. R > φ⁻¹ indicates coherent synchronization.
functions.ai_usage: Use to measure swarm coherence, collective behavior, synchronization quality.

functions.name: phi_mean
functions.ai_usage: Use for basic statistical analysis, centrality measures.

functions.name: phi_std
functions.ai_usage: Use for dispersion analysis, volatility measures, uncertainty quantification.

functions.name: phi_cor
functions.ai_usage: Use for correlation analysis, feature selection, dependency detection.

functions.name: phi_fft
functions.motoko_signature: fft_fft(signal: [{ re: Float; im: Float }]) : async [{ re: Float; im: Float }]
functions.candid_signature: fft_fft : (vec record { re: float64; im: float64 }) -> (vec record { re: float64; im: float64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Uses FFTW. Supports real input (imaginary part = 0).
functions.ai_usage: Use for frequency analysis, signal processing, spectral decomposition, convolution.

functions.name: phi_ifft
functions.motoko_signature: fft_ifft(spectrum: [{ re: Float; im: Float }]) : async [{ re: Float; im: Float }]
functions.candid_signature: fft_ifft : (vec record { re: float64; im: float64 }) -> (vec record { re: float64; im: float64 })
functions.numeric_notes: Inverse of phi_fft. FFT(IFFT(x)) = x within numeric tolerance.
functions.ai_usage: Use for inverse frequency transform, signal reconstruction.

functions.name: phi_monte_carlo
functions.motoko_signature: montecarlo_sample(f: (vec Float) -> Float, n: Nat) : async [Float]
functions.numeric_notes: Non-deterministic (random sampling). Default samples: φ⁵ × dim ≈ 11.09 × dim.
functions.ai_usage: Use for integration, probabilistic simulation, risk analysis. Heavy compute should be off-chain.

functions.name: linalg_inv
functions.numeric_notes: Requires non-singular matrix. inv(inv(A)) ≈ A within tolerance.
functions.ai_usage: Use for linear system solving, matrix equations. Prefer LU factorization for numerical stability.

functions.name: linalg_det
functions.ai_usage: Use for matrix singularity check, volume computation, system solvability.

functions.name: linalg_norm
functions.ai_usage: Use for distance computation, normalization, convergence checks.

performance.speedup_vs_js: 10-100× faster than pure JavaScript numerical computing

type_safe.claim: 100% type safe for supported bridge types
